title: One $100 payment gets you ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more for life
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Just one $99.99 payment gets you lifetime access to 1min.AI’s multi-model business and creative toolkit.

There’s productive multitasking, and then there’s keeping six AI tabs open while trying to remember which one was editing your image. 1min.AI simplifies that setup by bringing multiple AI models and content tools into one workspace.

You get multiple AI assistants, including GPT-5.5 Pro, GPT-5.4 Pro, Claude Opus and Sonnet models, several Gemini options, Llama 3, Mistral, and Command R. That gives writers, designers, social media managers, podcasters, and small business owners different models for different tasks.

Writing features cover keyword research, blog generation, rewriting, summarizing, grammar checking, brand voices, and social media comments. Image tools handle generation, upscaling, background replacement, object removal, face swapping, text editing, and sketch-to-image conversion.

The document section supports multi-document chats, translations, presentation generation, and PDF summaries, translations, and questions. Audio tools include text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music generation, voice changing, cloning, isolation, and translation.

This plan makes sense for someone who regularly works across several content formats and prefers one organized toolkit.

Don’t miss lifetime access to the 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan for a one-time $99.99 (MSRP $540).
